svg.title: How sentidoS works
svg.desc: The camera feeds Apple Vision, which drives ojoS and manoS. The microphone feeds Apple Speech, which drives bocaS. All of this runs on your Mac. An AI provider is optional and only receives transcript text, with your own key.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Video and audio never leave this Mac.
Transcript text goes out only if you add your own AI key.
